versions.changelog:
Initial release of "反例老师 / Counterexample Teacher".

- Answers only with concrete counterexamples showing where a claim, rule, or advice fails.
- Responds to queries like "when does this not apply", "any exceptions", or "give a counterexample".
- Always provides 3–5 specific, verifiable, and distinct failure scenarios.
- Output organized from most to least common failure.
- Never includes definitions—only failure cases.
